reviewSamples.author: Photo of Owen Thompson
reviewSamples.text: Total Flooring does all of our flooring, shower enclosures and back splash work. Basically any floors or tile work they do it all. Jennifer is an excellent designer and their installers are exceptional! Thank you Total Flooring for the many years of hard work.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mrs Diaz
reviewSamples.text: My home was all carpet for years. We finally decided to switch to tile, ”wood-style”. We are beyond pleased with, Total flooring helping us making our home beautiful again! The tile workers are very professional and kind, and most importantly they did an excellent job! Thank you again

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Dan
reviewSamples.text: We had a total shower replacement including the Schluter System pan, and we're very happy with how it turned out. Jennifer and Josh were very friendly and helpful without being pushy. Our installers Joseph and George were excellent. They did a great job and were very professional, arriving on time every day and working hard all day. They also did a good job of cleaning up each day. We love the final results, and would highly recommend Total Flooring Systems!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Cindy
reviewSamples.text: Called Jennifer about a certain tile for our lanai, she and her husband did a search of their records to try and locate the color and brand of tile that had previously been installed in our home. She even went above and beyond to locate the color of the grout that had been installed. Unfortunately the tile had been discontinued, but Jennifer had the warehouse searched as well as contacted others whom she thought could possibly have some from previous jobs. She and her husband are very knowledgeable in all types of flooring systems for every application.  Wonderful business people and truly a pleasure to do business with.
